description: This Java class 'DittoMetrics' provides static factory methods for creating various metrics instruments such as counters, gauges, histograms, and timers used in the Ditto Service metrics system. It centralizes metric creation with methods that generate configured instances, including support for tags.

classes.name: DittoMetrics
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods to create various metric instruments (timers, counters, gauges, histograms) used in the Ditto service.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Creates a new timer object for a metric with the given name using DefaultTimerBuilder.

methods.name: expiringTimer
methods.description: Creates an ExpiringTimerBuilder for a metric with the given name, allowing customization before starting the timer.

methods.name: counter
methods.description: Creates a Counter with the specified name via KamonCounter. Overloaded to accept optional tags.

methods.name: gauge
methods.description: Creates a Gauge with the specified name via KamonGauge.

methods.name: histogram
methods.description: Creates a Histogram with the specified name via KamonHistogram.
